sections.title: What an auto repair invoice must show
sections.body: A standard invoice template fails in a garage setting because it lacks space for vehicle specifics. You must record the vehicle registration, make, model, and current mileage on every document. This protects you from disputes and helps build a reliable service history. Your line items need strict separation between parts and labour. List each part with its exact part number and unit price. For labour, show the total hours worked multiplied by your standard shop rate. If you charge an environmental fee for oil disposal, list it as a separate line item rather than hiding it in the labour cost.
items: Vehicle registration and current mileage readings
Manufacturer part numbers for all replacement components
Labour hours multiplied by your shop rate
Separate line items for waste disposal fees

sections.title: How auto repair work is usually billed
sections.body: Mechanics rarely start work without approval. The standard sequence begins with a diagnostic check. You charge a flat diagnostic fee to find the fault, then provide a detailed estimate for the full repair. When the customer authorises the work, you proceed. Many garages then credit the initial diagnostic fee against the final bill as a courtesy. You can handle this entire workflow using our free invoice generator at /tools/free-invoice-generator without needing an account. Just create the estimate, wait for the customer to approve the parts and labour, and then generate the final invoice with a negative line item for the diagnostic credit.
items: Start with a flat fee for diagnostics
Provide a full estimate before starting repairs
Wait for explicit customer authorisation to proceed
Credit the diagnostic fee on the final invoice

sections.title: Getting paid for your garage services
sections.body: Auto repair relies heavily on cash flow to cover expensive parts. For large jobs like engine rebuilds or transmission replacements, you should request a deposit upfront to cover the component costs. The remaining balance is typically due upon collection of the vehicle. Your invoice terms must state clearly that the car will not be released until the bill is settled. If a customer leaves their vehicle at your shop for days after the repair is finished, you might also need to apply daily storage fees. Make sure your payment terms outline these storage conditions clearly before the work begins.
items: Request upfront deposits for high-cost replacement parts
Require full payment before releasing the vehicle
Include daily storage fees in your terms
Specify acceptable payment methods on the document

faqs.q: How do I list labour charges on a mechanic invoice?
faqs.a: You should separate labour from parts completely. Create a specific line item for the repair task. Enter your standard hourly shop rate as the unit price, and the number of hours the job took as the quantity. This shows the customer exactly how you calculated the final cost, which reduces arguments over the total bill.

faqs.q: Should I include the VIN on my repair invoices?
faqs.a: Including the Vehicle Identification Number is good practice, though the registration plate and mileage are usually enough for standard repairs. Recording the VIN helps if you need to order highly specific dealer parts or if you are maintaining a formal service history for warranty purposes. It also ensures there is no confusion about which vehicle received the service.

faqs.q: How do I handle diagnostic fees if the customer declines the repair?
faqs.a: If the customer decides not to proceed with the full repair after you find the fault, you simply invoice them for the diagnostic fee alone. You only apply a credit for this fee if they authorise the complete job. Ensure your initial estimate clearly states that the diagnostic charge applies regardless of their final decision.

faqs.q: Can I use this template for body shop work?
faqs.a: Yes, body shops can use the same billing structure. You will still need to list parts like panels or clips with their part numbers, and calculate labour for panel beating or painting based on your hourly rate. You can also add specific line items for paint materials and clear coats, separating them from the physical replacement parts.
